issues: Console hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Source: ReviewAutoPanel.jsx line 49 — `<option>{p.name}</option>` must be fine, but tr() wrapping or product name may contain nested elements. Low priority; UI still works.

action_items: (Optional) Silence hydration warning in ReviewAutoPanel.jsx — ensure the <option> label is a plain string (e.g. String(p.name)) if tr/i18n may wrap in <span>.

(Optional) run-now action takes ~2–5s because tick() scans up to 200 completed orders synchronously; consider offloading to background task or disabling the button during execution to prevent double-click.
critical_code_review_comments: review_auto.py seed_history() builds up to seed_total docs in memory before a single insert_many; for seed_total>>10k this would spike RAM. Current 1849 is fine; add batching if seed_total becomes configurable to very large.
review_auto.py order_auto_tick() limits to 200 orders per tick; backlog larger than that will take many ticks (60s each) — acceptable for current scale but noted.
review_auto.py line 272 awaits upload_b64 serially inside a list comprehension; up to 3 images so negligible, but could be gathered.

server.py GET /reviews returns up to 300 rows via to_list(300) and GET /reviews/stats uses aggregation; aggregation was slow (>30s) under heavy admin UI load — add an index on (product_id, visible) if not present. First invocation after redeploy took ~30s, subsequent calls <1s.
